name: _media.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  docs/_media.scss — responsive + print media — mobile backdrop-filter drop (GPU cost) and print exfiltration guard.
//  Imported by docs.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Mobile GPUs: backdrop blur is expensive — surfaces keep their
// near-opaque translucent bg and drop only the filter (app.scss contract).
@media (max-width: $bk-768) {
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-header,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-crumbs,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-nav,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-card,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-viewer {
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
    backdrop-filter: none;
  }
}

// Print-screen / print exfiltration: the protected region never prints.
@media print {
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-protected,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-viewer {
    display: none;
  }
}
